cases.sentence: Я послушался вас во всем, что вы мне сказали, и поставил над вами ___.
cases.translation: I have listened to you in all that you said to me, and have set a king over you.
cases.explain: The transitive verb поставил requires the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Теперь ваш вождь — ___, а я стар и сед.
cases.translation: Now your leader is a king, and I am old and gray-headed.
cases.explain: The predicate nominative after the verb быть requires the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Я был вашим вождем с ___ по сегодняшний день.
cases.translation: I have been your leader from my childhood to this day.
cases.explain: The preposition с (from) requires the genitive case.

cases.translation: Whose ox have I taken? Whose donkey?
cases.explain: The transitive verb взял requires the accusative case.

cases.sentence: После того, как Иаков пришел в Египет, и египтяне стали угнетать его ___, они воззвали к Господу.
cases.translation: After Jacob came into Egypt, and the Egyptians began to oppress his descendants, they cried out to the Lord.
cases.explain: The transitive verb угнетать requires the accusative case in the plural.

cases.sentence: Господь послал Моисея и Аарона, которые вывели ваших ___ из Египта.
cases.translation: The Lord sent Moses and Aaron, who brought your fathers out of Egypt.
cases.explain: The transitive verb вывели requires the accusative case in the plural.

cases.sentence: Если вы будете бояться Господа, служить Ему и слушаться Его, то прекрасно. Но если вы не будете слушаться Господа, то Его рука будет против ___.
cases.translation: If you fear the Lord and serve Him, all will be well. But if you do not obey the Lord, His hand will be against you.
cases.explain: The preposition против (against) requires the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Не жатва ли сейчас ___? Но я воззову Господу, и он пошлет гром и дождь.
cases.translation: Is it not wheat harvest now? But I will call to the Lord, and He will send thunder and rain.
cases.explain: In the nominative predicate construction with a genitive noun for harvest, жатва пшеницы follows the genitive.

reading.ru: Я послушался вас во всем, что вы мне сказали, и поставил над вами царя.
reading.question: What does Samuel say he has done at the beginning of his farewell address?
options: He listened to them and set a king over them
He refused to step down as judge
He divided the land among the tribes
reading.correct: He listened to them and set a king over them
reading.explain: Samuel begins by saying he heard their voice in all they said and made a king over them.

reading.ru: Свидетельствуйте против меня в присутствии Господа и его помазанника.
reading.question: What does Samuel ask the people to do?
options: Testify against him before the Lord and His anointed
Prepare for war against the Philistines
reading.correct: Testify against him before the Lord and His anointed
reading.explain: Samuel invites the people to witness against him and testify to his integrity before the Lord and his anointed.

reading.ru: Ты не обманывал и не притеснял нас, ты ничего ни у кого не брал.
reading.question: How do the people respond to Samuel's challenge?
options: They say he has not defrauded or oppressed them and took nothing from anyone
They accuse him of taking bribes
They thank him for his leadership
They ask him to continue as judge
reading.correct: They say he has not defrauded or oppressed them and took nothing from anyone
reading.explain: The people testify that Samuel has not defrauded or oppressed them and did not take anything from anyone.

reading.ru: После того, как Иаков пришел в Египет, и египтяне стали угнетать его потомков, они воззвали к Господу о помощи.
reading.question: What happened after Jacob's family went to Egypt?
options: The Egyptians oppressed his descendants and they cried to the Lord for help
They prospered and built great cities
They were made rulers of Egypt
reading.correct: The Egyptians oppressed his descendants and they cried to the Lord for help
reading.explain: The text recounts how the Egyptians began to oppress Jacob's descendants, who then cried out to the Lord.

reading.ru: Если вы будете бояться Господа, служить Ему и слушаться Его, не станете бунтовать против Его повелений, то прекрасно.
reading.question: What condition does Samuel set for Israel's future success?
options: If you fear the Lord, serve Him, obey His voice, and do not rebel, all will be well
If you defend your cities from enemies
If you keep the laws of Moses
If you make offerings at the temple
reading.correct: If you fear the Lord, serve Him, obey His voice, and do not rebel, all will be well
reading.explain: Samuel tells them that if they fear the Lord and serve Him, obeying His voice without rebelling, then all will be well.

reading.ru: Я буду наставлять вас на добрый и правильный путь.
reading.question: What does Samuel promise to do?
options: Instruct you in the good and right way
reading.correct: Instruct you in the good and right way
reading.explain: Samuel assures them 'I will instruct you in the good and the right way.'
